climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: An Oltrepò Pavese PDO in Lombardy for sparkling wine. Its rules allow just four grapes: Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio and Pinot Nero.
